utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What exactly needs fixing on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly the wiring and a couple of busted outlets, plus the back gate needs a new hinge.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can lend you my drill and a ladder if that helps with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks, Gus. I might need that ladder after all.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, I can bring the ladder by later today.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Pia, they’re still organizing folks for the repair drive, and I heard they could use a few more hands on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I might be able to help, but I need to know the timing and whether there’s parking before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s Saturday morning, around nine, and there’s parking in the lot behind the community center, so it should be easy enough if you can make it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that repair drive, Opal. Tell me what still needs fixing and I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam. The only thing left is the loose hinge on the side gate at 14 Maple and the wobbly step by the porch.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can take care of that. I’ll fix the hinge on the side gate at 14 Maple and steady the porch step next.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Uli. I’m sending the invite around now, and I’ll make sure folks know the repair drive is happening.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ll spread the word right away and make sure people know where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, Leo. I’ve got the repair drive organized, and I’ll keep the list tight so we can make real progress.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. Tell me what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Start with the leaks and any unsafe electrical issues, then we’ll move through the rest in order.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you walk me through what’s on the repair drive? I want to make sure I have the details right before I say yes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure, I can walk you through it. It’s just the main list of repairs and who’s handling what, so you can check the details before you decide.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That helps. What’s the full list, and who’s assigned to each repair?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that after school drop-off, if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That works for me. Thank you, I’ll be ready after drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I’ll see you then after drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard a little about that, but I’m not sure what’s actually happening yet.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s a volunteer repair drive for folks who need a hand with small home fixes. I can send you the details and the sign-up info if you want.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I’ll help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm you’ll actually do it?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yes, I’ll do it today.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is happening soon. Tell me what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think we need screws, a hammer, and maybe some tape, but I should double-check the list so I don't forget something.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it. I can bring the screws and tape, and I’ll wait to hear the final list before I grab anything else.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I’ll swing by and help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll set aside some supplies for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll be there, and I’ll bring whatever tools I can for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, good — I heard the repair drive’s moving along. I’ll check in after my errands and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can take a look after that. Thanks for checking in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good. I’ll check back after I’m done, and I appreciate you taking a look.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I meant to help with that, but I’ve got to check my notes first.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I still need a second to find my notes, but I haven’t forgotten the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I think I heard about that. What changed with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just a few parts got delayed. I’m checking the list now and will update you when it’s clear.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, just keep me posted when you know more.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring over my drill and a ladder if you need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That would be helpful, Gus. Bring them over, and I’ll keep the plan simple and work through it step by step.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll bring them by shortly, and we can keep the repair drive moving one step at a time.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with that repair drive. Tell me what still needs doing, and I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Mara. I’ll spread the word and let everyone know what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll keep an ear out for what still needs doing and be ready to help once you send it along.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Opal, I can help get the repair drive organized if you want. Just point me at the part that needs the most attention.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Start with the motor assembly near the rear bracket; that’s the part I’d check first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it, I’ll take a look at the motor assembly near the rear bracket first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the repair drive list ready, Cleo. Tell me which house you want to start with, and I’ll line up the volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Start with the east side if that works for you. I’ve got a few extra screws and a hammer I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, I’ll start on the east side and have the volunteers meet us there. Bring those tools and we’ll get the first house handled.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive is happening soon, but I only got that second-hand. What's the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I heard it's set for Saturday morning at the community hall, but I still want to confirm the exact time and what they need most.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That helps a lot. I’ll wait for the confirmed time, and if you hear what they need most, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can help with the repair drive. Just point me to what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You can confirm that, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I can confirm that.
